name: Spellmail

source.title: Pathfinder rules text (Foundry PF2E trait descriptions)

text: This armor is laced with magnetic flecks of mystical metal that enhance defensive magic. When you Cast a Spell that deals damage, you gain resistance to that damage type equal to 1 + the value of the armor's resilient trait until the start of your next turn. Armor with the spellmail trait automatically have the magical trait.
